description: This file contains Go source code implementing GraphQL query and mutation construction utilities, including functions for building query strings, handling argument types, and reflecting on struct types for GraphQL queries. It is part of a mock package for testing GraphQL interactions, specifically within the githubv4mock package.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds a GraphQL query string from a value and variables, including query arguments if variables are provided.

methods.name: constructMutation
methods.description: Builds a GraphQL mutation string from a value and variables, including mutation arguments if variables are provided.

methods.name: queryArguments
methods.description: Constructs a minified string of GraphQL query arguments from a map of variables, sorting keys for deterministic output.

methods.name: writeArgumentType
methods.description: Writes a minified GraphQL type for a reflect.Type to an io.Writer, indicating whether the type is required.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Generates a minified GraphQL query string from a struct value using reflection.

methods.name: writeQuery
methods.description: Recursively writes a minified GraphQL query string for a reflect.Type, inlining struct fields as needed.
